campaign_focus: KreekCraft's own reactions and personality in GTA 6: him laughing, screaming, getting scared, raging, or reacting to something unexpected; wild police chases, explosions and ridiculous encounters; funny fails; unexpected discoveries in Vice City. The first 1-2 seconds must hook. Titles and captions must describe exactly what happened: no misleading clickbait, no invented context. Captions must not contain links or URLs. Skip giveaway reading, sponsor segments, AFK or quiet driving. Also prioritise: funny GAME BUGS and glitches (NPCs or physics breaking, cars flying), big STORY moments and twists (with the streamer's reaction, no long cutscenes), the streamer's biggest REACTIONS, and moments where CHAT EXPLODES (<<CHAT Nx>> spikes).
